## Why visit

A worthwhile second Altrincham stop when you want independent cask alongside modern regional brewing. The downstairs room is compact, with additional space upstairs and a sheltered-feeling garden behind. Its useful contribution to a trip is variety: Costello’s concentrates on one local brewery, while Beacon provides a wider view of the region’s beer makers. Older guides may still call it Pi, so use the current name and address when navigating. It works best as part of an Altrincham cluster rather than displacing one of the major Manchester heritage pubs.

## Beer

CAMRA’s October 2026 entry reports three cask ales, often MBH/Mobberley, plus independent keg from regional breweries.
